items.description: Each if or else-if block (a plain else does not count)
Each case inside a switch (default does not count)
Each loop: for, for-in, for-of, while, do-while, or an iteration method (forEach, map, filter, reduce, some, every, find...) called on an array, Map or Set
Each try/catch block, regardless of the number of catches
Each arrow function with a block body { } or function expression passed as an argument (single-expression arrows do not count)

Each project type (class, interface, type alias or enum declared outside node_modules) the class references: injected dependency, parameter, return, instantiation, static use or decorator metadata. Counts 1 per distinct type, not per use.
